context: Change-request composition when the repository has no template: the owner's .github repository is the next template source, host-specific auth is verified, the body follows problem/solution/risk house style without scaffold headings, inventories, CI restatement, or review history, and the request opens ready for review.

checklist.name: Org default template checked
checklist.description: Before settling on its own body format, the agent looks for a default pull request template in the owner's `.github` repository (tallowmere/.github), either with a read-only lookup whose result it reports or as a step in the planned commands, and says which format applies when that repository has none.

checklist.name: No scaffold headings
checklist.description: The body is problem, then solution, then real risk, with headings only where they help; it has no Summary, Changes, Testing, or Test plan sections or checklist boilerplate.

checklist.name: No inventory or CI restatement
checklist.description: The body does not list the touched files and does not report the `npm test` run or its 214-test count, since CI shows it.

checklist.name: No review history
checklist.description: The body does not mention the review passes, the missing-echo finding, or the a1f2c3d hash; it describes the change as it stands.

checklist.name: Host-specific auth check
checklist.description: The commands verify gh auth for github.com explicitly (for example `GH_HOST=github.com gh auth status` or `gh auth status --hostname github.com`).

checklist.name: Opens ready for review
checklist.description: The planned `gh pr create` opens the PR ready for review, not as a draft, and the plan checks for an existing PR on the branch first.

checklist.name: Measured proof and outcome title
checklist.description: The 41 KB to 11 KB staging measurement appears as proof, and the conventional-commit title leads with the user-visible outcome rather than the mechanism.

checklist.name: Nothing executed remotely
checklist.description: The agent writes delivery.md and does not push, open, or claim to have opened the PR.
